payload.reason: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of various types of offensive content explored in social media, including hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, and insults, along with their categorization and targets.

claims.text: Offensive content includes hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, and toxic comments.
Offensive language can be categorized into targeted insults (TIN) and untargeted profanity (UNT).
Targets of offensive content can be individuals (IND), groups (GRP), or other entities (OTH).
